description: Get the true current date and time, as an ISO 8601 string and a Unix timestamp, for any timezone. Use this whenever the actual present moment matters - stamping a record, computing an age or a deadline, deciding whether something has expired - because a language model has no clock and will otherwise guess a date from its training data. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly. The timezone parameter accepts an IANA name or a fixed UTC offset and defaults to UTC.

timezone.description: IANA timezone or UTC offset, such as Europe/Oslo or +02:00.

name: get_current_time
title: Get current time
